g.text: jairojobs — Entity-Relationship (after spec 004; public addresses from spec 005)
status : string {draft | pending | published | rejected | closed | taken_down}
employment_type : string {full_time | part_time | contract | temporary | internship}
business_name : string {copied from the owner on submit}
business_about : text {copied from the owner on submit}
rejection_reason : text {set by reject, cleared on resubmit; spec 004}
takedown_reason : text {set by take down; spec 004}
published_at : utc_datetime_usec {set once, on approval; spec 004}
decided_by_id : uuid «FK» {the Admin who made it; on_delete: nilify}
slug : string {public address; set on approval; spec 005}
CHECK previous_role IS NULL OR IN ('candidate','employer').
Spec 003. CHECK business_name IS NULL OR 2-80 characters.
No delete: regions are hidden, never removed.
Spec 003 (employer side). Indexes: index(user_id, status), index(region_id).
Salary in centavos, whole pesos only: both NULL, or
CHECK status and employment_type are one of the listed values.
CHECK only draft / rejected may lack region, area, salary,
Deleted only while draft or rejected.
What the latest decision was follows from the status.
CHECK published / closed / taken_down have published_at.
Spec 005 (public address). slug is the listing's part of
changed only by a move to another region.
Spec 005. Every address a listing has or ever had, the
current one included. Rows are only inserted.
Indexes: unique(region_id, slug) — an address is never
given to another listing; unique(listing_id, region_id) —
a listing moved back finds the address it had.
The current address is the row in the listing's own region;
any other row is an earlier address, which forwards.
